# PropAI

> India's first real-time broker-network real estate intelligence platform for Mumbai.

PropAI parses live listings and requirements from private professional WhatsApp groups 
and makes them searchable via AI, MCP, and WhatsApp agent (Pulse).

## Key URLs
- Live stream: https://www.propai.live/listings
- MCP server: https://mcp.propai.live/mcp
- Locality directory: https://www.propai.live/localities
- For brokers: https://app.propai.live

## Coverage
Mumbai micro-markets: Andheri West, Bandra West, Bandra East, Juhu, Worli, Powai, Thane, Vashi

## Data
Real-time broker broadcasts, parsed by AI, updated within minutes of posting.
